question: Ram and Shyam start walking from the same place in the opposite direction. If Shyam walks at a speed of 5(1)/(4)km/hr and Ram at a speed of 3 km/hr, then after how much time will they be 44 km apart?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When two people move in **opposite directions**, their **relative speed** is the sum of their individual speeds.

**Relative Speed** = 5.25 + 3 = 8.25 km/hr.

**Time** = **Distance** ÷ **Relative Speed** = 44 ÷ 8.25 = 16/3 hours.

16/3 hours = 5 hours + (1/3 × 60) minutes = 5 hours 20 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 hr 20 min.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of **Shyam** = 5¹/₄ km/hr = 21/4 km/hr

Speed of **Ram** = 3 km/hr

Total **Distance** apart = 44 km

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f173e594cd932837efe43a4fccc3d626aff764fd00ee0e9cd3d2ddb310236da9.png] 

**Formula Used:**

**Relative Speed** (Opposite Direction) = Speed₁ + Speed₂

**Time** = Distance ÷ Relative Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Relative Speed** = 21/4 + 3

⇒ **Relative Speed** = (21 + 12) / 4 = 33/4 km/hr

⇒ **Time** = 44 ÷ (33/4)

⇒ **Time** = (44 × 4) ÷ 33

⇒ **Time** = (4 × 4) ÷ 3 = 16/3 hours

⇒ **Time** = 5¹/₃ hours

⇒ **Time** = 5 hours + (1/3 × 60) minutes

⇒ **Time** = 5 hours 20 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 5 hr 20 min.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Same Direction

When two objects move in the same direction, the relative speed is the difference of their speeds: |S₁ − S₂|.

Speed Unit Conversion

To convert speed from km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert from m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Average Speed for Constant Distance

If a person covers a distance at speed x and returns the same distance at speed y, average speed = (2xy) ÷ (x + y).</p
